description: Local-first, read-oriented MCP server for tracking public FOI/OIA request data and local correspondence.

runtime.configuration: DATABASE_URL and FYI_MCP_EPHEMERAL are documented environment settings

privacy.data_storage: Local SQLite storage; operators control the database path and retention.
privacy.telemetry: No product telemetry is required for the MCP server.
privacy.sensitive_data: Operators must avoid placing secrets or unnecessary personal data in local request records.

review_checklist: Verify the submitted version matches a GitHub Release and its checksums.
Verify the server starts in an isolated local environment.
Verify no tool silently submits a request to a public authority.
Verify the operator can disable network access and remove local data.
Record the public listing URL or rejection evidence in the registry ledger.
rollback: Remove the plugin listing and pin operators to the prior signed GitHub Release; no remote data migration is required.
